notes.title: Lot of fixes
notes.content:
Fixed the AI clock that it was not running in certain cases
Introduced an outline marker on the clock buttons
Now you can easily know the turn by looking at the clock buttons
Better timing for the AI (now you can use manual tap, the AI won't mark the clock as fast!)
Fixed validation for AI moves (no more accidental takebacks for the AI)
